title: Scrambled Tofu Breakfast Burrito with Carrot, Celery & Cilantro

steps.text: Cut the tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and small dice onion.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the onion and cook, stirring often, until slightly softened, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and coarsely grate carrots. Trim and mince celery. Add both to the skillet and stir to combine.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the skillet.

Crumble the tofu with your fingers into the skillet. Add soy sauce and spices; increase heat to medium-high and continue to cook, stirring often, until veggies are soft and tofu begins to brown, about 6 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Juice lime into the skillet; add cilantro and stir to combine.
Place tortillas on a flat surface, spread with mayo and top with tofu scramble. Tightly roll to close and cut in half. Enjoy!
